# Agent integration patches

Upstream base: `v0.6.0`, `fa29a30ad25e362acc349bea6ce4b025bdd8be5a`.
One patch remains from the earlier integration, the smallest change that keeps a behaviour the Agent depends on. It has an upstream issue asking for the same contract.

| File | Change | Why it survives | Pinning test |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| aimux-core/src/parse_tool_call.rs | Export `parse_json_input`. | `arcships/aimux#463`: the Agent drives the stream and executes tool calls itself, so it parses raw tool input through this function. | `dim-agent-aimux/src/stream.rs` calls it, so the crate does not compile without the export; `src/stream/tests.rs`: `errors_release_transport_and_do_not_expose_request_or_tool_input` pins its `InvalidToolInput` contract. |
| aimux-core/src/error.rs | Round a fractional `retry-after-ms` hint up to the next millisecond instead of truncating it. | `arcships/aimux#458`: a truncated hint starts a retry before the instant the server named. | `dim-agent-aimux/tests/model_flow/native.rs`: `native_failures_expose_only_normalized_model_facts` answers with `retry-after-ms: 25.1` and expects 26 ms. |
| aimux-core/src/recording.rs | Classify a key as sensitive when its name, with separators removed, ends in `key`, `auth` or `token`, or contains `secret`, in addition to the exact names the tag already lists. | `arcships/aimux#459`: configured connection headers such as `x-portkey-virtual-key` and `helicone-auth` would otherwise be recorded in clear text. | `dim-agent-aimux/tests/model_flow.rs`: `recorded_connection_headers_redact_sensitive_names`. |
| aimux-core/src/recording.rs | Ignore a `TransportClosed` event for a call the writer no longer holds, instead of recreating an empty entry for it. | `arcships/aimux#460`: the outcome wrapper and the HTTP layer both declare closure, and the second event appended a second, incomplete line for the same call id. | `dim-agent-aimux/tests/model_flow.rs`: `a_repeated_transport_close_does_not_append_an_incomplete_line`. |
| aimux-core/src/recording.rs | Write a record and its newline in one buffer, so overlapping recorder generations cannot split them. | `arcships/aimux#465`: a line at or above the 8 KiB buffer capacity is flushed before its newline, and a second recorder on the same directory interleaves into that gap. | `dim-agent-aimux/tests/model_flow.rs`: `overlapping_recorders_append_complete_jsonl_lines` writes 16 KiB records from two recorders and requires 256 complete lines. |
| aimux-providers/src/openai_compatible/chat/{api_types.rs,chat_language_model.rs} | Read the Chat delta's `refusal` field and emit its text as visible output. | `arcships/aimux#461`: a refusal is the model's answer; without this it produces an empty turn. The Agent's Chat protocols run on the OpenAI-compatible Chat model. | `dim-agent-aimux/tests/model_flow/native.rs`: `chat_refusal_delta_is_visible_text`. |
| aimux-providers/src/openai/responses/responses_language_model.rs | Turn `response.refusal.delta` into text deltas, and `response.refusal.done` into one copy only when no delta arrived for that part. | `arcships/aimux#466`: a refusal is the model's answer; without this a refusal on the Responses protocol ends as an empty turn. | `dim-agent-aimux/tests/model_flow/native.rs`: `responses_refusal_deltas_are_visible_text`. |
| aimux-providers/src/openai/{chat,responses}/*_language_model.rs | Send an explicitly selected `service_tier` for every model id; remove the model-name capability gate and the comment that described it. | `arcships/aimux#462`: the Agent reaches deployment aliases, and the product catalog and the remote account entitlement are the authorities for the tier. | `dim-agent-aimux/tests/model_flow/native.rs`: `explicit_preferences_reach_chat_and_responses_for_model_aliases`; `dim-app-server/tests/provider_flow.rs`: `vendor_routes_agree_across_selection_and_actual_http_execution`. |
| aimux-providers/src/google/{language_model.rs,convert_to_messages.rs} | Start a new text block when a signed part follows a block with a different signature; keep unsigned parts in the open block; keep an empty signed part in the stream and on replay; close text and reasoning before a function call, in part order. | `arcships/aimux#467`: Gemini signs each text part separately and expects the signature replayed with its part, so merging differently signed parts loses the boundary and the earlier signature. | `dim-agent-aimux/tests/model_flow/native.rs`: `gemini_signed_text_parts_keep_their_blocks`; `four_native_apis_preserve_signed_blocks_and_tool_continuation`. |
| aimux-providers/src/openai/responses/{responses_language_model.rs,convert_to_responses_input.rs} | Open one text block per `output_text` content part and carry the `function_call` item id in tool metadata, then replay it as the item's id. | `arcships/aimux#468`: Responses returns one item per message with per-part content and an id on each item; merging parts and dropping the `function_call` id loses that structure. | `dim-agent-aimux/tests/model_flow/native.rs`: `responses_output_text_parts_and_function_call_ids_are_kept`; `four_native_apis_preserve_signed_blocks_and_tool_continuation`. |

The workspace member list is reduced to the four crates the Agent uses; production source is retained verbatim except for the change above.

The Agent turns on `CallOptions.strict_stream` for every call, so the stream contract itself is the tag's. The checks that remain in the adapter are the product rules: an unsupported warning fails the call, provider-executed tools and provider-generated files, sources and tool results are refused, and a content-filtered or errored finish is a failed turn.

The vendored tree carries production source only. The three regression test files the integration used to add were removed with the upgrade; their assertions are covered by the existing model-flow suites.

The patch does not add timeouts, retries, repair, or new model configuration fields, and nothing here enables Core orchestration or host-side tool-call repair in the Agent.
